nodes.description: uint256 public serviceValue: service fee rate used in fee calculations
mapping(address=>mapping(uint256=>Order)) public order_place: listed orders per seller and tokenId

mapping(uint256=>bool) public _operatorApprovals: token approval flag

mapping(uint256=>mapping(address=>uint256)) public balances: internal token balance ledger
uint256 public tokenCount: counter of minted tokens
address private _owner: contract owner used by Ownable
modifier onlyOwner: require(owner() == msg.sender)
renounceOwnership(): sets _owner to address(0)
transferOwnership(address newOwner): changes _owner
owner(): returns _owner
Sale constructor: serviceValue = _serviceValue * 2 with unchecked multiplication
_orderPlace(address,uint256,uint256): creates an order after checking balances
_cancelOrder(address,uint256): deletes the caller order and clears flags
_changePrice(uint256,uint256): lowers the order price
_acceptBId(...): pulls BEP20 funds and distributes fee, royalty and net amount
checkTokenApproval(uint256,address): requires listing and approval flags
_saleToken(...): native ETH distribution to admin, creator and seller
calc(uint256,uint256,uint256): computes admin fee, royalty and net amount
percent(uint256,uint256): value1.mul(value2).div(100)
setServiceValue(uint256): serviceValue = _serviceValue.mul(2)
ExchangeContract constructor: passes _serviceValue to the Sale constructor
serviceFunction(uint256) public onlyOwner: updates the service fee
transferOwnershipForColle(address,address,address) public onlyOwner: transfers ownership of NFT bank contracts
mint(...): mints on a user-supplied token contract and records balances/creator/royalty
setApprovalForAll(...): sets _operatorApprovals[tokenId] = true and calls the token contract
saleToken(...) public payable: pays ETH out then updates order and balances
acceptBId(...): accepts a bid, pulls ERC20 then updates order and balances
orderPlace(uint256,uint256) public: places an order for msg.sender
